title: Longitudinal static stability -- cruise and approach
objective: To demonstrate that the simulation of static longitudinal stability conforms to the validation data.
tolerance_catalog: Positive stick force / airspeed gradient | ± 2.2 daN (5 lbs) or ± 10% column force | ± 1.5 cm (0.6 in) column position
runtime_configuration: Existing main.py test settings and common engine remain authoritative
